design.summary: Gaunt-looking but chunky dark mage in teal robes and bone-white armour, a skull hood, and a long bone staff.
design.silhouette: Large skull-shaped hood, hunched wide shoulders with rib-plate armour, long robe, a tall bone staff topped by a small skull and a pale flame.

headgear.description: A teal hood whose front is a white skull mask with dark eye hollows (the face is the skull), a ridge of small bone spikes along the top.

armour.description: Bone-white shoulder plates shaped like ribs.
Rib-cage breastplate of bone white over a deep teal robe.
Teal sash with a small hanging skull and a bone clasp.
Dark teal pointed boots with bone toe caps.

design.cloth: A long deep-teal robe with a tattered hem and a short tattered teal cape with pale teal edges.
design.weapon_summary: A long staff made of three lashed bones topped with a small skull that holds a pale teal flame; carried in the right hand.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: bone staff
weapon.description: A long staff made of three lashed bones topped with a small skull that holds a pale teal flame; carried in the right hand.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: the back of the skull hood (plain teal with a ridge of small bone spikes), rib plates on the back, the tattered cape, staff shaft at the right side.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the tattered robe hem and cape.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the tattered robe hem and cape sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the tattered robe hem and cape settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the tattered robe hem and cape.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the tattered robe hem and cape flares.
Wind-up: staff pulled back horizontally behind the right shoulder, body coiled.
Staff swung forward and down in a diagonal arc, skull tip leading, robe snapping.
Strike: staff thrust forward at full reach, skull tip far ahead of the body, front knee bent.
Follow-through: staff swept low to the left, torso twisted, cape flaring.
Recover: staff drawn back upright at the right side, cape settling.
Gather: staff raised straight up, left palm opening beside the chest, flame flickering.
Staff held overhead, pale flame growing, skull hood tilted back, arms rising.
Arms spread wide, staff overhead in the right hand, robe flaring, chest out.
Thrust: staff pointed forward at shoulder height at full reach, left hand clawed forward.
Recover: staff lowering upright, flame shrinking, robe settling.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, the bone staff held upright at the right side, left hand open loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
